title: Hotel and shopping center
content: Is anyone familiar with the nail shop in the raggedy shopping center, on the top floor across from the hotel? The hotel has old fashioned furniture, but small amenities, like red plush chairs, and the hallways feel uncomfortable. Across the street, perhaps in the same large parking lot, there's a 2 story shopping center. There's an overpriced nail salon. The hotel, I'd like to say feeds into the casino, but I'm unsure. It may just be that both have red furnishings. Familiar to anyone else?
